title: AOL Explorer
summary: AOL Explorer was a free Windows graphical web browser released in July 2005, distributed as a standalone download or bundled with AOL Instant Messenger. It used Microsoft's Trident layout engine and supported tabbed browsing, pop-up blocking, and spyware detection. Version 1.5 (May 2006) added Desktop Widgets, Visual Themes, a Feeds Screensaver, and page preview features. The browser was briefly succeeded by AOL OpenRide in 2006 and then AOL Desktop in 2007.

mechanisms.title: Rendering and engine
mechanisms.explanation: The browser used Microsoft's Trident layout engine to render web content and supported Internet Explorer-compatible plugins.
